name: Singing City
description: An ancient Kor ruin on the Na Plateau in Murasa on Zendikar, whose eerie harmonic resonance drives visitors mad; it was destroyed in Nissa's burst of energy.

description_citations.text: "Singing City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aida Lunda plans to journey into the heart of the Singing City, hoping to learn the Eldrazi message.
timeline.quote: I can feel a breakthrough coming.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Zendikar: Murasa and Sejiri
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Zendikar: Murasa and Sejiri". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Feb 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jace enters the Singing City and meets Nahiri, who refuses to give up the Core and attacks him.
timeline.quote: Never," she snarled.

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The city's haunting song nearly drives Jace mad until he casts a silencing spell that also saves Nahiri.
timeline.quote: A spell that blocked out any sound entering his ears.

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reveals through telepathy that she will channel the Core through the city's focal point, and Jace agrees not to hinder her if she holds off using it until they study it.
timeline.quote: Runes said there's a magical focal point there that can channel the Core's energy all over Zendikar through the leylines.

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Jace find the focal point destroyed, and Nissa arrives with Ashaya, claiming the elementals destroyed it.
timeline.quote: It was," Nissa replied, coldly, "until the elementals destroyed it.

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa feels betrayed when Jace sides partly with Nahiri; Nahiri hurls swords at Nissa.
timeline.quote: Nahiri created dozens and dozens of glowing swords.

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya merge in full power and attack Nahiri, who flees with Jace through the city.
timeline.quote: The Soul of the Wild seemed to swell with strength, with the drive to protect.

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa and the elementals, speeding along Zendikar's paths, cut them off at the city gates.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is where I belong. It's the heart of my power and strength,

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The elementals surge forward as the battle for Zendikar's soul begins.
timeline.quote: The battle for Zendikar's soul had begun, and it would be a ruthless fight.

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Jace takes control of Nahiri's mind and takes the Lithoform Core.
timeline.quote: Jace turned the tables on her and took control of her mind.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa uses the Core to flatten the Singing City and heal Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Jace witnessed how she flattened the Singing City into dust and restored Zendikar's soil.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace promises not to hinder Nahiri if she does not use the Core until they have studied it.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren promised to not hinder her in her endeavor to save Zendikar

citation.text: "Lithoform Core", section "The Singing City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa and her elementals have destroyed the focal point and attack Jace and Nahiri; Jace takes control of Nahiri's mind and the Core, but Ashaya takes it and hands it to Nissa.
timeline.quote: he was caught by Ashaya who took the Core and handed it to Nissa herself.

citation.text: "Lithoform Core", section "The Singing City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa learns the Core is a piece of Zendikar's soul and uses its power against Nahiri's hedrons; the Singing City and part of the forest are flattened.
timeline.quote: The Singing City was gone.

citation.text: "Lithoform Core", section "The Singing City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa destroys the Singing City on the Na Plateau with the Lithoform Core.
timeline.quote: It was destroyed when Nissa used the Lithoform Core .

citation.text: "Murasa", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa destroys Nahiri's focal point in the Singing City with Ashaya and her elementals.
timeline.quote: Nissa had destroyed it with Ashaya and her other elementals

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa uses the Lithoform Core, which levels the Singing City and then heals Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Singing City was gone.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa, backed by Kazandu elementals, confronts Jace and Nahiri and orders the elementals to defend Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Defend Zendikar," she said to the elementals

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri battles the elementals but is overwhelmed, her swords brushed aside, and retreats into the Singing City.
timeline.quote: She didn't stop until she reached the massive marble gates of the Singing City and pushed through them.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Jace slips into the city as Nahiri walls off the entrance with stone.
timeline.quote: a massive wall of stone crushing the marble gates of the city

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri builds a fortress; Jace pleads to go to Ravnica but she traps him in a ring of hedrons.
timeline.quote: trapping Jace within the dangerous ring

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees Sorin and attacks, but it is a Jace illusion, and Jace seizes control of her mind.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, her thoughts were not her own.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Jace takes the Lithoform Core from Nahiri's satchel and resists its temptation.
timeline.quote: Took the Lithoform Core.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Jace escapes the city with the Core, but Ashaya pins him and tosses the Core to Nissa.
timeline.quote: And into Nissa's waiting hands.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa speaks mind-to-mind with Jace while the Core's voice, which is Zendikar itself, speaks to her.
timeline.quote: I am me. I am you.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes Jace is trying to take control of her mind, snaps the link and has Ashaya hold him down.
timeline.quote: Jace was trying to take control of her mind.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Nahiri that Nahiri is what Zendikar once was and Nissa is what it is now.
timeline.quote: You are what Zendikar once was, Nahiri. I am what it is now.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa merges her magic with the Core, colliding with Nahiri's hedrons and flattening the Singing City.
timeline.quote: Nissa's magic merged with the Core's power.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The Core's power heals Zendikar, reviving the elementals and making the Eldrazi wastes bloom.
timeline.quote: Zendikar was healing, turning into something healthier, stronger than it was before the battle with the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri berates Jace and planeswalks away; Jace resolves to apologize to Nissa.
timeline.quote: He didn't try to argue as the ancient kor turned and planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Jace and Akiri travel to the Singing City seeking Nahiri and the Lithoform Core; Jace escapes the maddening music with a sound-blocking spell.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Akiri traveled to the city in search of Nahiri

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya confront Nahiri and Jace; Nissa destroys the leyline focal point, halting Nahiri's plan to activate the Core.
timeline.quote: A battle ensued that culminated in Nissa destroying the leyline focal point

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa confronts the fleeing Jace and Nahiri at the city's threshold and demands they leave the plane.
timeline.quote: She demanded they leave the plane, reaffirming her role as its guardian.

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace infiltrates the city, traps Nahiri's mind with a psychic illusion and seizes the Core, but Ashaya takes it and gives it to Nissa.
timeline.quote: he trapped her mind with a psychic illusion and seized the Core

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Core tells Nissa telepathically that it is a piece of Zendikar created to undo damage.
timeline.quote: revealing that it was a piece of Zendikar and was created to undo damage

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace tries to seize control of Nissa's mind and Ashaya restrains him; Nissa merges the Core's power with her own as Nahiri attacks.
timeline.quote: Nissa tapped into the Core's power and merged it with her own, unleashing a powerful burst of energy.

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The explosion destroys the Singing City; Zendikar begins visibly healing and Nissa discards the Core and departs.
timeline.quote: The explosion destroyed the Singing City

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri blames Jace and planeswalks away; Jace is left remorseful, hoping redemption is possible.
timeline.quote: Nahiri, angry and bitter, blamed him and planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: It was destroyed when Nissa used the Lithoform Core .

pages_say.description: A ruin on the Na Plateau named for eerie music from its underground chambers, which drives explorers mad.

citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Zendikar: Murasa and Sejiri". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Feb 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.
